test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

You can become __confident to speak__ English within one year.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'confident in speaking'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Confident in speaking"** is the correct grammatical structure when expressing proficiency or self-assurance in an ability, such as language skills.
 
• The preposition** "in" **is commonly used with the adjective **"confident"** to describe certainty in one's capabilities in a particular area or activity.
 
 
• **Example**: Alex was confident in speaking during the meeting.
 
 
 
• The phrase fits naturally into the context of developing language skills, making it a suitable substitution for "confident to speak".

Therefore, the correct answer is- You can become *confident in speaking__* English within one year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Convinced to speaking** (Option 1) uses incorrect grammatical structure and implies persuasion rather than self-assurance.
 
• **Reassured of speaking **(Option 2) suggests being given confidence by someone else, which doesn't fit the context of personal development in language proficiency.
 
• **Assured of speaking **(Option 3) also doesn't fit as neatly as "confident in speaking". It more so implies a guarantee from another source rather than an internal sense of confidence.
